name: job-search-agent
description: Find, verify, and score current job openings against a candidate-approved profile.

interface.shortDescription: Find and verify roles for each candidate.
interface.longDescription: Build a candidate-specific search profile, verify current employer postings and application deadlines, score matches, maintain a validated Excel tracker and shortlist, and support scheduled-run receipts even when no new jobs are found. Each candidate supplies their own resume and preferences.
defaultPrompt: Build my candidate profile from my resume.
Find and verify current jobs that match my profile.
Run my recurring search and update the Excel tracker.
